rule: Retryable-error tuples in the Postgres hook must use the narrowest psycopg error subclasses (e.g. UndefinedColumn, UndefinedTable) from the correct package (psycopg for v3, psycopg2 for v2) — never a broad class like OperationalError.
trigger: diff defines a _POSTGRES_RETRYABLE_ERRORS tuple that includes psycopg.OperationalError or any other broad psycopg exception class
rationale: OperationalError covers connection failures, timeouts, OOM, and disk I/O errors — none fixable by retrying a query. Only schema-mismatch errors like UndefinedColumn/UndefinedTable justify automatic retry.
